propositions: pin_health.derive_health classifies related pins as stale-pin-drift when only the latest fingerprint matches, ignoring supported historical full-hash generations that would match the signed pin

an unchanged related ticket pinned under a post-330c/pre-2be7 fingerprint is incorrectly rejected as stale after the algorithm changed in commit 1afdbbd0be, despite the historical recomputation exactly matching the signed value
the attestation layer supplies only current_material_fingerprint to derive_health, omitting the full-hash compatibility check already applied to own-ticket validity by _legacy_material_ok
a mismatched latest fingerprint should be reclassified as current when recomputing the current related ticket under a supported historical generation exactly matches the signed pin
genuine related-material drift and unmatched arbitrary hashes must remain classified as stale-pin-drift after the fix
